prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Pilar, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Pilar thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: SOFTEN: add doubt, or make the claim milder and less certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "Starting next month the neighborhood council will fine anyone who leaves their bins on the sidewalk after 8am."
text: I heard a rumor that the council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am, though I’m not sure how much truth there is to it. They certainly don't need any more rules, so hopefully this is just talk.
